description: Three random path switches: two send one input to one of two outputs, and the third sends one of two inputs to a single output. A pulse switches the path, by a chance set on that section

params.text: Sets the chance of a pulse switching the path, from 0% where it never switches to 100% where every pulse switches it
Switches the path of that section by hand
Resets that section by hand, which arms it again once its one shot has been used
With it on that section switches its path only once and has to be reset before it will switch again; a red lamp shows that the one switch has been used
Resets all three sections at once

inputs.text: The signal into that switch, which reaches one of its two outputs
One of the two signals into the third switch, of which one at a time reaches its output
A pulse switches the path of that section, by the chance set with PROBABILITIES
A voltage added to the chance set by PROBABILITIES on that section
A pulse resets that section, which arms it again once its one shot has been used
A pulse switches the one shot mode of that section on
A pulse resets all three sections at once

outputs.text: One of the two outputs of that switch; it carries the input while the path is set to that side, and either 0V or the last voltage it had while it is not, as the menu is set
Carries whichever of the two inputs the path is set to
Passes on each pulse that arrives at the TRIG jack of that section, for driving another section or another module from it

menu: Unselected Outuputs 0 Volts — an output the path is not set to drops to 0V; the item is printed with that spelling
Unselected Outuputs Last Voltage — an output the path is not set to holds the last voltage it carried, which makes it a sample and hold
USE A/B switching probability mode — reads PROBABILITIES as the chance of a pulse moving the path away from the side it is already on, so where it has been matters
USE A/B routing probability mode — reads PROBABILITIES as the chance of the path going to one particular side whatever side it was on
